1.1: Yesh meviin bikkurim vekorin, meviin velo korin, veyesh sheenan meviin. ellu sheenan meviin, hannotea letoch shello vehivrich letoch shel yachid o shel rabbim, vechen hammavrich mittoch shel yachid o mittoch shel rabbim letoch shello. hannotea letoch shello vehivrich letoch shello, vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim baemtza, hare ze eno mevi. rabbi yehuda omer, kaze mevi:
1.2: Meeze taam eno mevi, mishshum shenneemar, reshit bikkure admatcha (Shemot 23), ad sheyyehu chol haggiddulin meadmatcha. haarisin vehechachorot vehassikkarikon vehaggazlan, en meviin meoto hattaam, mishshum shenneemar, reshit bikkure admatcha:
1.3: En meviin bikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminim. lo mittemarim shebbeharim, velo mipperot shebbaamakim, velo mizzete shemen sheenam min hammuvchar. en meviin bikkurim kodem laatzeret. anshe har tzevoim heviu vikkurehem kodem laatzeret, velo kibbelu mehem, mippene hakkatuv shebbattora (Shemot 23) vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade:
1.4: Ellu meviin velo korin, hagger mevi veeno kore, sheeno yachol lomar asher nishba Adonai laavotenu latet lanu (Devarim 26:3). veim hayta immo miyyisrael, mevi vekore. ucheshehu mitpallel beno leven atzmo, omer, elohe avot yisrael. ucheshehu vevet hakkeneset, omer, elohe avotechem. veim hayta immo miyyisrael, omer, elohe avotenu:
1.5: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, ishsha vat gerim lo tinnase lakkehunna, ad shettehe immah miyyisrael. echad gerim veechad avadim meshuchrarim, vaafillu ad asara dorot, ad shettehe imman miyyisrael. haappotroppos vehashshaliach vehaeved vehaishsha vetumtum veanderoginos, meviin velo korin, sheenan yecholin lomar (Devarim 26:10) asher natatta li Adonai:
1.6: Hakkone shete ilanot betoch shel chavero, mevi veeno kore. rabbi meir omer, mevi vekore. yavash hammayan, niktzatz hailan, mevi veeno kore. rabbi yehuda omer, mevi vekore. meatzeret vead hechag, mevi vekore. min hechag vead chanukka, mevi veeno kore. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, mevi vekore:
1.7: Hifrish bikkurav umachar sadehu, mevi veeno kore. vehashsheni, meoto hammin eno mevi, mimmin acher, mevi vekore. rabbi yehuda omer, af meoto hammin mevi vekore:
1.8: Hifrish bikkurav, nivzezu, namakku, nignevu, avdu, o shennitmeu, mevi acherim tachtehem veeno kore. vehashsheniyyim enam chayyavim alehem chomesh. nitmeu vaazara, nofetz veeno kore:
1.9: Uminnayin shehu chayyav beacharayutan ad sheyyavi lehar habbayit, shenneemar (Shemot 23) reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha, melammed shechayyav beacharayutam ad sheyyavi lehar habbayit. hare shehevi mimmin echad vekara, vechazar vehevi mimmin acher, eno kore:
1.10: Veellu meviin vekorin, min haatzeret vead hechag, mishshivat hamminim, mipperot shebbeharim, mittemarot shebbaamakim, umizzete shemen, meever hayyarden. rabbi yose haggelili omer, en meviin bikkurim meever hayyarden, sheenah eretz zavat chalav udevash:
1.11: Hakkone shelosha ilanot betoch shel chavero, mevi vekore. rabbi meir omer, afillu shenayim. kana ilan vekarkao, mevi vekore. rabbi yehuda omer, af baale arisut vechachorot, meviin vekorin:

2.1: Hatteruma vehabbikkurim, chayyavim alehen mita vechomesh, vaasurim lezarim, vehem nichse chohen, veolin beechad umea, uteunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh. hare ellu vitruma uvikkurim, ma sheen ken bammaaser:
2.2: Yesh bemaaser uvikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma, shehammaaser vehabbikkurim teunim havaat makom, uteunim vidduy, vaasurin laonen. rabbi shimon mattir. vechayyavin babbiur. verabbi shimon poter. vaasurin kol shehen milleechol birushalayim. vegiddulehen asurim milleechol birushalayim af lezarim velabbehema. rabbi shimon mattir. hare ellu bammaaser uvabbikkurim, ma sheen ken batteruma:
2.3: Yesh batteruma vevammaaser ma sheen ken babbikkurim, shehatteruma vehammaaser osrin et haggoren, veyesh lahem shiur, venohagim bechol happerot, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, uvaarisin uvechachorot uvassikkarikon uvaggazlan. hare ellu vatteruma uvammaaser, ma sheen ken babbikkurim:
2.4: Veyesh babbikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma uvammaaser, shehabbikkurim niknin bimchubbar lakkarka, veose adam kol sadehu bikkurim, vechayyav beacharayutam, uteunim karban veshir utenufa velina:
2.5: Terumat maaser shava labbikkurim bishte derachim, velatteruma bishte derachim. nittelet min hattahor al hattame, veshello min hammukkaf, kabbikkurim. veoseret et haggoren, veyesh lah shiur, katteruma:
2.6: Etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim, velayyarak bederech echad. shave lailan, baarla uvarvai uvashsheviit. velayyarak bederech echad, shebbishat lekitato issuro, divre rabban gamliel. rabbi eliezer omer, shave lailan bechol davar:
2.7: Dam mehalleche shetayim, shave ledam behema, lehacheshir et hazzeraim. vedam hashsheretz, en chayyavin alav:
2.8: Koy, yesh bo derachim shave lachayya, veyesh bo derachim shave labbehema, veyesh bo derachim shave labbehema velachayya, veyesh bo derachim sheeno shave lo labbehema velo lachayya:
2.9: Ketzad shave lachayya, damo taun kissuy kedam chayya, veen shochatin oto beyom tov, veim shechato, en mechassin et damo, vechelbo metamme vetumat nevela kachayya, vetumato vesafek, veen podin bo peter chamor:
2.10: Ketzad shave labbehema, chelbo asur kechelev behema, veen chayyavin alav karet, veeno nilkach bechesef maaser leechol birushalayim, vechayyav bizroa ulechayayim vekeva. rabbi eliezer poter, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:
2.11: Ketzad eno shave lo lachayya velo labbehema, asur mishshum kilayim im hachayya veim habbehema, hakkotev chayyato uvehemto livno, lo chatav lo et hakkoy, im amar hareni nazir shezze chayya o vehema, hare hu nazir. ushear kol derachav, shavim lachayya velabbehema, vetaun shechita kaze vechaze, umetamme mishshum nevela umishshum ever min hachay kaze vechaze:

3.1: Ketzad mafrishin habbikkurim. yored adam betoch sadehu veroe teena shebbikkera, eshkol shebbikker, rimmon shebbikker, koshro vegemi, veomer, hare ellu bikkurim. rabbi shimon omer, af al pi chen chozer vekore otam bikkurim meachar sheyyittalshu min hakkarka:
3.2: Ketzad maalin et habbikkurim. kol haayarot shebbammaamad mitkannesot lair shel maamad, velanin birchovah shel ir, velo hayu nichnasin labbattim. velammashkim, haya hamemunne omer (yirmeya lo), kumu venaale tziyyon el bet Adonai elohenu:
3.3: Hakkerovim meviim hatteenim vehaanavim, veharchokim meviim gerogarot vetzimmukim. vehashshor holech lifnehem, vekarnav metzuppot zahav, vaateret shel zayit berosho. hechalil makke lifnehem, ad shemmaggiim karov lirushalayim. higgiu karov lirushalayim, shalchu lifnehem, veitteru et bikkurehem. happachot, hasseganim vehaggizbarim yotzim likratam. lefi chevod hannichnasim hayu yotzim. vechol baale ummaniyyot shebbirushalayim omdim lifnehem veshoalin bishlomam, achenu anshe hammakom peloni, batem leshalom:
3.4: Hechalil makke lifnehem ad shemmaggiin lehar habbayit. higgiu lehar habbayit, afillu agrippas hammelech notel hassal al ketefo venichnas, ad shemmaggia laazara. higgia laazara vedibberu haleviyyim bashshir, aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani velo simmachta oyvay li (tehillim 30):
3.5: Haggozalot sheal gabbe hassallim, hayu olot. uma shebbeyadam, notnim lakkohanim:
3.6: Odehu hassal al ketefo, kore mehiggadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha (Devarim 26), ad sheggomer kol happarasha. rabbi yehuda omer ad arammi oved avi. higgia laarammi oved avi, morid hassal meal ketefo veochazo vesiftotav, vechohen manniach yado tachtav umenifo, vekore mearammi oved avi ad shehu gomer kol happarasha, umannicho betzad hammizbeach, vehishtachava veyatza:
3.7: Barishona, kol mi sheyyodea likrot, kore. vechol mi sheeno yodea likrot, makrin oto. nimneu millehavi, hitkinu sheyyehu makrin et mi sheyyodea veet mi sheeno yodea:
3.8: Haashirim meviim bikkurehem biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav, vehaaniyyim meviin otam besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa, vehassallim vehabbikkurim nittanin lakkohanim:
3.9: Rabbi shimon ben nannas omer, meatterin et habbikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminim. rabbi akiva omer, en meatterin et habbikkurim ella mishshivat hamminim:
3.10: Rabbi shimon omer, shalosh middot babbikkurim, habbikkurim, vetosefet habbikkurim, veittur habbikkurim. tosefet habbikkurim, min bemino. veittur habbikkurim, min besheeno mino. tosefet habbikkurim neechelet betohora, ufetura min haddemay. veittur habbikkurim chayyav baddemay:
3.11: Ematay amru tosefet habbikkurim kabbikkurim, bizman shehi vaa min haaretz. veim enah baa min haaretz, enah kabbikkurim:
3.12: Lema amru habbikkurim kenichse chohen, shehu kone mehem avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea, uvaal chov notlan bechovo, vehaishsha vichtubbatah, kesefer tora. verabbi yehuda omer, en notnim otam ella lechaver betova. vachachamim omrim, notnin otam leanshe mishmar, vehem mechallekin benehem, kekadshe hammikdash:

4.1: Anderoginos yesh bo derachim shave laanashim, veyesh bo derachim shave lannashim, veyesh bo derachim shave laanashim venashim, veyesh bo derachim eno shave lo laanashim velo lannashim:
4.2: Ketzad shave laanashim: metamme beloven kaanashim, vezokek leyibbum kaanashim, umitattef umistapper kaanashim, venose aval lo nissa kaanashim, vechayyav bechol mitzvot haamurot battora kaanashim:
4.3: Ketzad shave lannashim: metamme beodem kannashim, veeno mityached im haanashim kannashim, veeno over al "bal takkif" velo al "bal tashchit" velo al "bal tetamme lammetim" kannashim, ufasul min haedut kannashim, veeno nival baavera kannashim, venifsal min hakkehunna kannashim:
4.4: Ketzad shave laanashim velannashim: chayyavim al makkato veal killato kaanashim vechannashim, vehahorgo shogeg gole umezid neherag kaanashim venashim, veyoshevet alav dam tame vedam tahor kaanashim vechannashim, vecholek bekadshe kodashim kaanashim vechannashim, venochel lechol hannechalot kaanashim vechannashim, veim amar "hareni nazir shezze ish veishsha" hare ze nazir:
4.5: Ketzad eno shave lo laanashim velo lannashim: en chayyavim lo al makkato velo al killato lo kaanashim velo kannashim, veeno neerach lo kaanashim velo kannashim, veim amar "hareni nazir shezze lo ish velo ishsha" eno nazir. rabbi meir omer: anderoginos beriyya bifne atzmah hu velo yachlu chachamim lehacheria alav im hu ish o ishsha. aval tumtum eno ken, peamim shehu ish peamim shehu ishsha:
